name: Adapty Android SDK

dataTypes.when: Always. Adapty says this collection is required and cannot be turned off.

dataTypes.type: Device or other IDs / Device or other IDs
dataTypes.when: Always (Adapty lists Device ID). Adapty's page shows the purposes for this type only as screenshots; App functionality and Analytics mirror its other answers and should be checked.

ask: Do you explicitly pass name, email or phone number to the Adapty SDK (e.g. updateProfile)? If yes, declare Personal info / Name, Email address and/or Phone number.
Do you use Adapty integrations with third parties that are not your service providers (e.g. ad/attribution networks)? If yes, Adapty says you may need to mark data as shared.
notes: Adapty: data encrypted in transit; not processed ephemerally; deletion possible from dashboard or REST API (answer 'Yes' only if users can contact you to request it). Not collected: location, health, photos/videos, files, calendar, contacts, browsing/search history, app info and performance. Maven artifacts verified on Maven Central (io.adapty group).
